candidates.title: 트랜잭션에 대한 흔한 오해
candidates.concept_granularity: single pair of mistakes about Kafka transactions: believing exactly-once extends past writes to Kafka, and assuming a consumer always reads a whole transaction and knows where its boundaries are

candidates.title: 부수 효과에는 적용되지 않는다
candidates.concept_granularity: single boundary confining the guarantee to records written to Kafka, so any external effect a processing step causes - an email, a REST call, a file write - still happens once per attempt

candidates.title: 외부 데이터베이스 쓰기의 한계
candidates.concept_granularity: single gap where a result goes to an external database through a driver while the offset is committed to Kafka, with no mechanism joining the two, leaving storing the offset in the database and relying on its transaction as the workaround

candidates.title: 아웃박스 패턴
candidates.concept_granularity: single workaround for the dual-write problem in which the service writes only to an outbox and a relay service applies the update, requiring the update itself to be idempotent because Kafka guarantees nothing about it

candidates.title: 종단 보장의 한계
candidates.concept_granularity: single limit on chaining a database read through Kafka into another database, because read_committed only hides uncommitted records and never tells the consumer where a transaction started, ended, or how much of it has arrived

candidates.title: 클러스터 간 복제의 한계
candidates.concept_granularity: single distinction between copying each record exactly once across clusters, which MirrorMaker 2.0 can do, and preserving the transaction's atomicity, which is lost in the copy

candidates.title: 발행/구독 패턴에서의 한계
aliases: 오프셋 커밋 로직에 따른 중복 처리
candidates.concept_granularity: single shortfall in publish-subscribe use, where read_committed consumers do skip aborted records - comparable to a JMS transaction - but the offset commit logic can still make a consumer process a message more than once

candidates.title: 커밋 전 응답 대기 데드락
aliases: 커밋 전 응답 기다리는 패턴 금지
candidates.concept_granularity: single anti-pattern of writing a message and waiting for another application's reply before committing, which deadlocks because the reader cannot see the message until the commit

candidates.title: processing.guarantee
aliases: 카프카 스트림즈 정확히 한 번 활성화
candidates.concept_granularity: single Kafka Streams setting that turns on exactly-once, the recommended way to use transactions because Streams then drives the transaction API on the application's behalf

candidates.title: 트랜잭션은 프로듀서 쪽 기능
candidates.concept_granularity: single placement fact that creating the transactional producer, beginning, writing records and offsets, and committing or aborting all happen on the producer, while the transaction is also a broker feature

candidates.title: 컨슈머 그룹 메타데이터 펜싱
candidates.concept_granularity: single option from Kafka 2.5 pairing the transactional id with consumer group metadata for fencing, requiring a distinct id per application instance so one consumer's failure fences only that instance and the rest keep their transactions running

candidates.title: 트랜잭션 마커
candidates.concept_granularity: single control message the coordinator writes to every partition in a transaction to mark it committed or aborted, ordered by a two-phase commit against the __transaction_state log so a partial write is recoverable

candidates.title: 트랜잭션 API 흐름
candidates.concept_granularity: single call sequence from registering the transactional id through beginning, announcing each new partition, sending the processed offsets and ending with a commit or abort the coordinator records

candidates.title: transaction.timeout.ms
candidates.concept_granularity: single deadline after which the coordinator aborts a transaction that has neither committed nor aborted

candidates.title: Last Stable Offset
candidates.concept_granularity: single read barrier under read_committed at the start of the oldest open transaction, holding later messages back until that transaction commits, aborts, or times out, which lengthens end-to-end delay while it stays open

candidates.title: 트랜잭션 성능
candidates.concept_granularity: single cost profile in which registration and partition announcements are one-off, commit markers and the synchronous wait are per transaction, so throughput rises as more messages fit in one transaction while read_committed still lengthens end-to-end delay
